newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit rangebound, subdued by strong dollar/yen.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit rangebound, subdued by strong dollar/yen.

text.p: The ringgit retained mild early gains and was bound to a narrow range in late Asian trading with activity subdued by strong dollar/majors, dealers said on Monday.
They said sentiment was still in favour of the ringgit despite rumours of a possible trade deficit for November expected to be announced this week.
"The market is still looking to sell dollars. But, dollar/majors strength is keeping things quiet," said the head of dealing at a foreign bank in Kuala Lumpur.
He said the market was unable to ignore the dollar's rise against other major currencies.
"Market is looking for correction in dollar/majors before any rally in the ringgit resumes," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank in Kuala Lumpur.
He said the ringgit would trade in the 2.4750 to 2.4900 a dollar range in the near-term.
At 0930 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4829/39 a dollar after trading in the 2.4815/75 range.
Against the Singapore dollar, it was at 1.7651/70.
